name: beautifulrepo
description: Audit a repository with BeautifulRepo's local, read-only Python checks and agent-guided documentation checklists.

interface.shortDescription: Audit a repository's README, trust files and links with local checks.
interface.longDescription: Run BeautifulRepo's read-only, offline Python checks and checklists against a local repository to get evidence-backed findings about its README, license, contribution guide, links and first-success path. The agent session may send repository context to its configured model provider.
